tools.name: get_stock_info
tools.description: Get stock information for a given ticker symbol from yahoo finance. Include the following information: Stock Price & Trading Info, Company Information, Financial Metrics, Earnings & Revenue, Margins & Returns, Dividends, Balance Sheet, Ownership, Analyst Coverage, Risk Metrics, Other.

ticker.description: The stock ticker symbol (e.g., AAPL, MSFT, GOOG)

tools.name: get_historical_stock_prices
tools.description:
Get historical stock prices for a given ticker symbol from yahoo finance. Include the following information: Date, Open, High, Low, Close, Volume, Adj Close.
Args:
    ticker: str
        The ticker symbol of the stock to get historical prices for, e.g. 'AAPL'
    period : str
        Valid periods: 1d,5d,1mo,3mo,6mo,1y,2y,5y,10y,ytd,max
        Either Use period parameter or use start and end
        Default is '1mo'
    interval : str Valid intervals: 1m,2m,5m,15m,30m,60m,90m,1h,1d,5d,1wk,1mo,3mo
        Intraday data cannot extend last 60 days
        Default is '1d'

ticker.description: The stock ticker symbol (e.g., AAPL, MSFT, GOOG)

period.description: The period for the historical data (e.g., 1d, 5d, 1mo, 3mo, 6mo, 1y, 2y, 5y, 10y, ytd, max)

interval.description: The interval for the historical data (e.g., 1m, 2m, 5m, 15m, 30m, 60m, 90m, 1h, 1d, 5d, 1wk, 1mo, 3mo)
